Drinking on a cruise is generally straightforward, though rules on age, outside alcohol, and pricing depend on the cruise line and itinerary . Most North American cruises set the minimum drinking age at 21, while many non-U.S. departures set it at 18.⁠Royal Caribbean Cruises  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF15IoJ2rUTmarvXcGndYt9TpVgB9PtTO7H1G8dBy-kiT_9qIKtZ8CFulzPd-BXAu7TDMEXUgXGT2QCqp-3F2_TjpWFPOQ9brQ7ln-jqC85nAugSA5mBLRA_af-BOARgPJE_KAUm1BzvfoF3hUvhJkASENBBGzaqgl5Zz6K4votLIcg6EKrQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1zbjqqpL-uqYY-JPfYUsUJGLuxoLyuIV8mB838U6dcY_mGJbgYpw87r3C2PJb8GS84008OuTf64oIr7wZvUyVDOEH3wDwrzgxNe1HiZYZ_UBr0-ogGBE3Sp1MHkKJUqCOMO3Li4jQltOgSgb7PxN_gLoF0q6dvTyizA2sChy0vE9Mg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOPv_f3AXZfiVqQ0wckrpDPloFl930oa4Nwc8VY_IGYwm8r2BOEq8Gl3M_G_PoA3o3cj7JaqNKGwsUtYpMGuYTR4F5ew7OVzNw4pktWjGzm9G2sWq_b9CqXwNY5_fZg6XcSnfigMT)

### Key Policies & Rules

- **Drinking age:** Usually **21** on cruises departing from the U.S. or North America, and **18** on many European, Asian, Australian, or South American sailings (subject to cruise line rules and local laws).⁠All Things Cruise  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1zbjqqpL-uqYY-JPfYUsUJGLuxoLyuIV8mB838U6dcY_mGJbgYpw87r3C2PJb8GS84008OuTf64oIr7wZvUyVDOEH3wDwrzgxNe1HiZYZ_UBr0-ogGBE3Sp1MHkKJUqCOMO3Li4jQltOgSgb7PxN_gLoF0q6dvTyizA2sChy0vE9Mg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF15IoJ2rUTmarvXcGndYt9TpVgB9PtTO7H1G8dBy-kiT_9qIKtZ8CFulzPd-BXAu7TDMEXUgXGT2QCqp-3F2_TjpWFPOQ9brQ7ln-jqC85nAugSA5mBLRA_af-BOARgPJE_KAUm1BzvfoF3hUvhJkASENBBGzaqgl5Zz6K4votLIcg6EKrQ)
- **Bringing alcohol onboard:** Spirits and beer are usually prohibited. Many lines allow a limited amount of wine or champagne at embarkation, sometimes with a corkage fee in dining areas.⁠All Things Cruise  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF1zbjqqpL-uqYY-JPfYUsUJGLuxoLyuIV8mB838U6dcY_mGJbgYpw87r3C2PJb8GS84008OuTf64oIr7wZvUyVDOEH3wDwrzgxNe1HiZYZ_UBr0-ogGBE3Sp1MHkKJUqCOMO3Li4jQltOgSgb7PxN_gLoF0q6dvTyizA2sChy0vE9Mg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOPv_f3AXZfiVqQ0wckrpDPloFl930oa4Nwc8VY_IGYwm8r2BOEq8Gl3M_G_PoA3o3cj7JaqNKGwsUtYpMGuYTR4F5ew7OVzNw4pktWjGzm9G2sWq_b9CqXwNY5_fZg6XcSnfigMT)
- **Onboard conduct:** Avoid excessive drinking, do not buy alcohol for underage guests, and never leave drinks unattended. For more tips on etiquette and safety, see Cruise Critic (Wait—I must use exact URL from results: `https://www.cruisecritic.com/articles/12-rules-of-drinking-on-a-cruise-ship`).⁠Cruise Critic[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF10Dlijlz8yV0bV1qbQ0v9Ycu3MGCkqn0LzkZKTYqFQAGE-Q8q-kp6nImfTNskQ1jNsANaNUznIQzxrLblP58zMLbojAeJfuV3ajdpkd28jTRX1P7_XocndhJh7sO6OHjuDAXWTsz1gf4Lwk5D7ph4y0Cn5hEc2L6MssDGBrATNtCsw)

### Pacing & Saving Money

- **Pace yourself:** Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1_5J6uGx8HXo5zzgKgNX1mI6R4wcHRG9N6tDPldzcGc-7-yK8TrZyNGlejHuplrEdLLBkvzuaX-TYR7P08ty826YvXR22e9-6nnbrm3rSqpdQ3sdXGxCDj4fgCLm2BUJIyaXcDOPMT8UPsWa5wOR73b8wA29-_25yVnIEmBA7d3FcsxtbN6foyfNLrWm2VZ8bo8) agree that alternating drinks with water, eating regularly, choosing less sugary drinks, packing electrolyte packets, and taking daytime naps help prevent hangovers and keep energy up.⁠Reddit·r/Cruise[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1_5J6uGx8HXo5zzgKgNX1mI6R4wcHRG9N6tDPldzcGc-7-yK8TrZyNGlejHuplrEdLLBkvzuaX-TYR7P08ty826YvXR22e9-6nnbrm3rSqpdQ3sdXGxCDj4fgCLm2BUJIyaXcDOPMT8UPsWa5wOR73b8wA29-_25yVnIEmBA7d3FcsxtbN6foyfNLrWm2VZ8bo8)
- **Watch the costs:** Drink packages add up quickly, so look for "drink of the day" specials, happy hours, loyalty perks, or drinks ashore in port. You can also check out [this video on cruise drink hacks](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXG4bIyTwEm2zPhMP4KalBSjvJrsmwzNT7v4cW96Y5VRYbsDWSC4Uz0JFds1Y-oVLUy_wya-R_l_zGF05VRWmkC2eYBTPoSrK7AP2uNum3QrQgF7xad9Vn5aIgdZeKjCRqNA) for extra ways to cut bar costs without a package.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOPv_f3AXZfiVqQ0wckrpDPloFl930oa4Nwc8VY_IGYwm8r2BOEq8Gl3M_G_PoA3o3cj7JaqNKGwsUtYpMGuYTR4F5ew7OVzNw4pktWjGzm9G2sWq_b9CqXwNY5_fZg6XcSnfigMT)

If you are planning a trip, tell me **which cruise line or route** you have in mind, **whether you drink heavily or casually** , and **if you are deciding on a drink package** , so I can help you figure out what makes sense.
